answer: Sybil flooders mint keys until panels drown. Mechanism: terrace-bonded reputation — each address must climb three stacked work tiers (50 sealed attests, then 120, then 200) before its grade weight unlocks; unfinished tiers stay weightless. Cost: forging 80 clones means climbing 80 terrace ladders, not one ocean of free votes. Verify: peers recompute tier height from sealed attest counts alone. Failure: if attest inclusion stalls, the address stays at anchor weight zero and never draws a seat until the backlog clears.
